cadence_event_policy: all collection events in the evaluation horizon
sample_limitations: 48-hour geometry; request times sampled within the first 47 hours; 24 draws paired across A0-A6 within each fixed Walker/site/thread/terminal/condition cell, with independent draws across Walker and site cells; nominal cadence is one deterministic full pass sequence, while degraded cadence has six denial draws. Wilson intervals describe sampled uncertainty only, not model uncertainty or operational validity

scenario_labels.MT1_TIME_SENSITIVE_CUEING: rapid area update (legacy key retained for file compatibility)
scenario_labels.MT3_BATTLE_DAMAGE_ASSESSMENT: generic change assessment (legacy key retained for file compatibility)

source_classification.imagery_benchmark: measured laptop data is not calibrated into this analysis
source_classification.mission_utility: assumed tier sufficiency, not demonstrated capability
source_classification.orbital_access: synthetic TLE plus SGP4 geometry; not measured access
source_classification.terminal_sites: synthetic locations, not operational terminal locations
